latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of What Is AI Video — Generate and Export AI Videos:

- Instantly transform 60-second raw screen recordings into 1080p AI-generated videos by describing your desired outcome.
- Upload video clips, generate edits, add overlays, and export videos via simple prompts—no manual timeline editing or export settings required.
- Seamless onboarding: auto-connects to the backend, supports free token generation, and session setup.
- Live cloud rendering pipeline: outputs MP4 and other formats in 30–90 seconds per export.
- Supports file uploads (up to 500MB), credits balance, preview of current tracks, and download of final renders.
- Smart prompt routing—detects user intent (upload, export, credits, etc.) for quick action.
